composition_subtypes.role: Preprocess: sort edges, retain smallest k edges, extract relevant vertices
Run Dijkstra from each vertex on reduced graph to compute all-pair distances

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorts edges to keep only top k, then runs all-pairs Dijkstra on the induced small subgraph to find k-th smallest shortest path.
payload.rationale: Utilizes sorting to reduce problem size, then exhaustive graph search (Dijkstra as BFS variant) to accurately count and locate the k-th distance.
